lines.en: The Fox and the Crow Early one morning, a fox is walking through the woods.
lines.zh: 狐狸和乌鸦：一天清晨，一只狐狸在树林里走着。

lines.en: He is hungry, and he is looking for something to eat.
He sees a crow sitting on the highest branch of a tree.
lines.zh: 他看见一只乌鸦停在树最高的那根树枝上。

lines.en: The crow has a piece of cheese in her beak.
lines.zh: 乌鸦嘴里叼着一块奶酪。

lines.en: Mmm, I love cheese, thinks the fox.
I think I've found my breakfast.
lines.zh: 我想我的早餐有着落了。

lines.en: But how can I get the cheese?
lines.zh: 可我怎么才能拿到那块奶酪呢？

lines.en: He thinks and thinks.
Then he has a clever idea.
lines.zh: 后来他想出了一个好主意。

lines.en: I will make her talk.
He sits at the bottom of the tree and looks up at the crow.
lines.zh: 他坐在树下，抬头看着乌鸦。

lines.en: Good morning, Miss Crow, he says.
It's a lovely day, isn't it?
The crow looks down at the fox.
She says nothing.
I said, "Good morning," says the fox.
"Did you hear me?
Maybe you can't hear me up there."
The crow is suspicious.
She holds the cheese tightly in her beak and says nothing.
lines.zh: 她把奶酪紧紧叼在嘴里，一句话也不说。

lines.en: Hmm, this is not so easy, thinks the fox, but he doesn't give up.
lines.zh: “嗯，这可不太容易，”狐狸心想，但他没有放弃。

lines.en: He smiles at the crow.
"You know, you really are the most beautiful bird," he says.
lines.zh: “你知道吗，你真的是最美的鸟，”他说。

lines.en: "Your feathers are so shiny.
Your eyes are so intelligent.
Your beak is so um pointy.
Everything about you is perfect."
lines.zh: 你身上每一样都完美无缺。”

lines.en: Still, the crow says nothing.
So, the says, "Tell me, Miss Crow, is your voice also magnificent?
lines.zh: 于是他又说：“告诉我，乌鸦小姐，你的声音是不是也一样了不起？

lines.en: I hear that you have the most wonderful voice.
lines.zh: 我听说你的嗓音最美妙了。

lines.en: Please sing for me, just one song.
lines.zh: 请为我唱一首吧，就唱一首。

lines.en: Then I can tell everyone you really are the most incredible bird.
lines.zh: 这样我就可以告诉所有人，你真的是最了不起的鸟。

lines.en: The queen of all birds, in fact."
This makes the crow feel good.
lines.zh: 这番话让乌鸦心里很受用。

lines.en: She wants everyone to know she has a wonderful voice.
lines.zh: 她想让所有人都知道她有一副好嗓子。

lines.en: She wants everyone to know that she is the queen of all birds.
lines.zh: 她想让所有人都知道，她是鸟中之王。

lines.en: She smiles a little smile.
Then she smiles a big smile.
Then she opens her mouth to sing her best song for the fox.
lines.zh: 然后她张开嘴，要为狐狸唱她最拿手的一首歌。

lines.en: And plop!
The cheese drops out of her beak and falls straight into the mouth of the fox.
lines.zh: 奶酪从她嘴里掉了出来，径直落进狐狸的嘴里。

lines.en: He swallows it in one gulp.
Mmm.
"Thank you for the delicious breakfast, Miss Crow," laughs the fox as he walks away.
lines.zh: “谢谢你美味的早餐，乌鸦小姐，”狐狸笑着走开了。

lines.en: "Have a lovely day."
Moral: Beware of flatterers.
They often want something from you.
lines.zh: 他们多半是想从你这里得到点什么。
